The '''Vispil system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Thrasybule sector/Legends|Thrasybule sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Vispil]].
